# Shift AI Tech

> UK AI studio that builds custom AI products, automation, and websites that get found and convert.

Shift AI Tech (legal: Shift AI Technology Ltd, Companies House 17159725) is a founder-led AI product studio based in Southminster, Essex, United Kingdom. We build custom AI models, agents, RAG pipelines, full-stack products, and marketing websites for businesses that need a commercial edge.

Disambiguation: not Shift Technology (insurance AI at shift-technology.com), not Shift AI at shiftai.co.uk (automotive dealer tools), not SHIFT AI LTD (Newcastle, 17222733), and not other unrelated "Shift AI" brands. Our domain is exclusively https://shiftaitech.com.

- [Websites](https://shiftaitech.com/websites/): Fixed-price website design, build, host, and SEO foundations
- [Our Story](https://shiftaitech.com/our-story/): How we funded neural models for Bitcoin prediction and cut rebuild cost 82% with AI tooling

- [Onboarding](https://shiftaitech.com/onboarding/): Start a project with Shift AI Tech

## Services

- Custom AI: models, agents, and RAG on your data
- Product builds: concept to live deployment
- Automation: replace slow manual workflows
- Strategy: scoped, priced AI opportunities before you commit
- Websites: bespoke design/build/host with SEO foundations
